title: Angie Nixon Notches Another Win for the Left Through Old-Fashioned Organizing
summary: State Representative Angie Nixon scored a stunning upset on Tuesday in Florida’s Democratic Senate primary. Her victory will test the strength of a democratic socialist in a red state.
